title: Split at the root
text: cos(t) is positive on $$[0,\frac{\pi}{2})$$ and negative on $$(\frac{\pi}{2},pi]$$, so split the integral at $$t=\frac{\pi}{2}$$.

title: Evaluate
text: The integral of cos(t) from $$0$$ to $$\frac{\pi}{2}$$ is $$1$$, and the integral of $$-cos(t)$$ from $$\frac{\pi}{2}$$ to pi is $$1$$. The total is $$2$$.
